description: The Contentful App makes your Contentful spaces accessible to AI agents, enabling them to perform content management operations. Once installed, the app gives space admins a simple dashboard to control exactly which Contentful tools are available to AI clients: enable read-only access for marketing teams auditing content, or unlock write tools for developers building agentic workflows. Each space gets its own configuration.
